title: Super admin editing switches now work
problem: Super admin's merchant-editing switches were marked Planned and changed nothing for stores.
now: Switches lock the matching parts of the merchant's builder with the reason, and presets follow each theme's packages.
steps: In the super admin open the Signal theme
Switch off Colours and fonts and read what it hides
In the merchant panel open Theme › Customize › Brand & colours: the options show as locked
Back in the super admin, see the Merchant preset card with its packages
notes: Where: Super admin › Storefront themes › a theme (/admin/themes/view?id=signal) · Needs the server: Locks apply to the theme assigned to Dazzle Shop; a store with no theme follows the default switches.
